title: Downalod Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central icons (logos)
summary: The post gives download links for Business Central icons. The new icon (aka.ms/BCicon) comes as a PDF, as PNGs from 48x48 to 256x256, and as an SVG, with a README on usage rights. The old Business Central icon is offered as an SVG only.
key_points: The new Business Central icon is available at aka.ms/BCicon
The new icon comes as a PDF, as PNGs in sizes from 48x48 to 256x256, and as an SVG
A README file about usage rights can be downloaded
The old Business Central icon is available as an SVG only

quotes.why_it_matters: Provides direct access to the current official Business Central icon asset
